---
name: Term request
about: Request a new HeritageGraph term, or a change to an existing one
title: "[term] "
labels: term-request
---

**Term** (proposed label and kind: class, property or enumeration value)

**Definition** (one or two sentences)

**Example** (a real case, with its documented source: a publication, an archive record, a DANAM entry, ...)

**Competency question** (the question this term lets a user answer)

**Existing terms considered** (CIDOC-CRM, PROV-O or HeritageGraph terms that come close, and why they do not fit)

**Community and access considerations** (is this knowledge held by a community? is it restricted, e.g. agam or initiates-only? does it concern identifiable people?)
